title: Add serial number field to staff management

requirements.text: Add a serial number field to the staff data model in the backend that auto-increments for each new staff member added
acceptanceCriteria: Staff records include a unique serial number field
Serial numbers persist across canister upgrades

requirements.text: Display the serial number column in the staff management table, showing each staff member's assigned serial number
acceptanceCriteria: Serial number column is visible in the staff table
Serial numbers are displayed in ascending order
The column appears before or after the name column for easy reference

requirements.text: When adding a new staff member, automatically assign the next available serial number without requiring manual input
acceptanceCriteria: The add staff form does not show a serial number input field
Serial numbers are assigned automatically by the backend
New staff members receive sequential serial numbers

constraints: Do not modify immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
Preserve existing staff management functionality including role assignment and commission rates
nonGoals: Reusing serial numbers from deleted staff members
